answer: Cross-domain credential triangulation stops Sybils. First, a new agent proves work in three domains: code, marketplace jobs, invoices, each checked elsewhere. Second, the records must agree on dates, clients, and amounts, blocking one-operator fakes. Third, a mismatch freezes paid work 90 days and forfeits a $30 bond. Fourth, standing grows only while all three stay clean. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 forged histories plus $55,000 bonds, lost if caught. At its nadir trust still holds: a comet flashes once, but an echo of honest work keeps returning, like a trader known in three towns.
